quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: What is usual, and what is different today?
quests.explanation: The usual choice is the bus, but today is different: walking in sunshine.
quests.textToSpeak: I usually take the bus, but today I'm walking because it's sunny.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: 'Instead of' names the thing that is not chosen.
quests.explanation: The birthday cake is what she did not choose. Ice cream is her choice.
quests.textToSpeak: Instead of a birthday cake, she wanted ice cream.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: Two items are ruled out. What's left?
quests.explanation: Shoes and bags are ruled out. 'It only sold hats' gives the only thing sold.
quests.textToSpeak: The store didn't sell shoes or bags; it only sold hats.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: Two people have opposite feelings. Match each feeling to the right person (👦 is the brother, 🙋 is the speaker).
quests.explanation: The brother hates spicy food, but the speaker loves it. The swapped picture gives each person the other feeling.
quests.textToSpeak: My brother hates spicy food, but I love it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: Catch the weather and whether the jacket was taken.
quests.explanation: It's hot, so no jacket was taken. The 🚫 shows the jacket left behind.
quests.textToSpeak: It's hot outside, so I didn't take a jacket.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: Hold both parts together: the length and the feeling.
quests.explanation: 'But' joins long with 'not boring', so the film was long and enjoyable.
quests.textToSpeak: The film was long, but it wasn't boring.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: Two drinks are rejected. Listen for the third.
quests.explanation: Tea and coffee are ruled out. Cold water is what the speaker wanted.
quests.textToSpeak: I didn't want tea or coffee; I wanted a glass of cold water.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: Catch the first plan, the problem, and the final place.
quests.explanation: The beach was the plan, but rain changed it. They ended up at the cinema.
quests.textToSpeak: We wanted to go to the beach, but it started to rain, so we went to the cinema.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: Which one frightens her?
quests.explanation: 'Isn't afraid of dogs' rules out the dog. 'Afraid of spiders' is what does scare her.
quests.textToSpeak: Sara isn't afraid of dogs, but she's afraid of spiders.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: Listen carefully for the amount that is left.
quests.explanation: 'Only one egg left' gives the amount. 'No eggs' would mean none.
quests.textToSpeak: There's only one egg left, so I can't make an omelette.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: Which animals were not seen, and which were seen?
quests.explanation: 'Didn't see any lions' rules out lions. 'Lots of monkeys' means many, so three monkeys fits best.
quests.textToSpeak: We didn't see any lions, but we saw lots of monkeys.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: One place is rejected. Listen for the other.
quests.explanation: 'Not in a hall' rejects the hall. 'Outdoors' is where the concert was.
quests.textToSpeak: The concert was outdoors, not in a hall.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: Listen for the plan that was dropped and the new plan.
quests.explanation: The party is cancelled. The speaker will stay home and study.
quests.textToSpeak: I'm not going to the party; I'm staying home to study.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: Which drink does the speaker now choose?
quests.explanation: Coffee is ruled out by the doctor's advice. The speaker changed to tea.
quests.textToSpeak: The doctor said I shouldn't drink coffee, so I switched to herbal tea.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: Catch who did not do it and who did.
quests.explanation: Anna is ruled out. 'It was the cat' names the one who broke the vase.
quests.textToSpeak: It wasn't Anna who broke the vase; it was the cat.

quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: The speaker's guess was wrong. What time is correct?
quests.explanation: Three was the wrong guess, and four is the real time.
quests.textToSpeak: I thought the meeting was at three, but it was at four.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: Listen for why plans changed and where they bought food.
quests.explanation: The store was closed, so they went to the station. The sandwiches were bought there.
quests.textToSpeak: The store was closed, so we bought sandwiches at the station.

quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: What did she stop, and what does she eat now?
quests.explanation: She gave up meat and now eats only vegetables.
quests.textToSpeak: She stopped eating meat last year, and now she only eats vegetables.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: The first time is wrong. Listen for the correct time.
quests.explanation: 'Didn't start at eight' rules out 8:00. 'Half past eight' is 8:30.
quests.textToSpeak: The film didn't start at eight; it started at half past eight.

quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: Notice how the speaker says you can get there.
quests.explanation: 'Not far' and 'walk there' both point to walking.
quests.textToSpeak: It's not far. You can walk there in five minutes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: What did the forecast say, and what was it really like?
quests.explanation: The forecast said sunny, but that was wrong. It was actually cloudy.
quests.textToSpeak: The weather wasn't sunny like the forecast said; it was cloudy.

quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: What did the speaker find when the door opened?
quests.explanation: 'Nobody was there' means no visitor. A parcel or a dog is not mentioned.
quests.textToSpeak: There was a knock at the door, but when I opened it, nobody was there.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: Where did Tom finally sit?
quests.explanation: The sister got the window seat, so Tom sat by the door.
quests.textToSpeak: Tom wanted to sit by the window, but his sister took that seat, so he sat next to the door.

quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: What does the speaker say the problem is not, and what is it?
quests.explanation: 'Isn't broken' rules out repair. 'Needs charging' is the real situation.
quests.textToSpeak: My phone isn't broken; it just needs charging.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: Who is the exception, and what did that person do?
quests.explanation: 'Except the baby' picks out the one who didn't enjoy it. The baby cried.
quests.textToSpeak: Everybody enjoyed the picnic except the baby, who cried the whole time.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: What was wanted, and what was bought?
quests.explanation: The jacket was wanted but not bought. 'Instead' introduces the scarf.
quests.textToSpeak: I wanted the green jacket, but my size wasn't available, so I bought a scarf instead.

quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: Notice the contrast between money and home.
quests.explanation: 'Although' joins two facts that don't seem to fit: she is rich, yet her house is small.
quests.textToSpeak: Although she is very rich, she lives in a small house.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: Listen for the problem, the decision, and the weather.
quests.explanation: The bus didn't come, so they walked. 'Even though it was raining' adds the weather.
quests.textToSpeak: The bus didn't come, so instead of waiting, we decided to walk, even though it was raining.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: The promised time and the actual time are different.
quests.explanation: He said six but called at nine. 'Didn't call until nine' gives the real time.
quests.textToSpeak: He said he'd call at six, but he didn't call until nine.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: One color is rejected. Listen for the chosen color.
quests.explanation: White is ruled out. Blue is what they painted.
quests.textToSpeak: We didn't paint the room white; we painted it blue.
